title: Speaking Practice 9 - Shopping and Fashion
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about shopping habits and fashion preferences.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Shopping and Fashion
stimuli.content: Answer questions about your shopping habits and fashion sense.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about shopping.

explanation.sampleAnswer: It depends on what I'm shopping for. I enjoy browsing bookstores and electronics shops, but I find clothes shopping a bit tedious.

questions.content: Do you prefer shopping online or in stores?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I mostly shop online now because it's more convenient and I can compare prices easily. But for clothes, I still prefer trying them on in person.

questions.content: What was the last thing you bought?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I bought a pair of wireless earbuds last week. I needed them for my online classes and commuting.
Not particularly. I tend to go for comfortable and practical clothing rather than following the latest trends.

questions.content: Has the way people shop changed in recent years?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, dramatically. E-commerce platforms like Shopee and Lazada have become incredibly popular, especially since the pandemic.
